entries.title: I Opened Seven Issues for One Feature (On Purpose)
entries.summary: One feature. Seven real issues. Four hours. Zero babysitting.
claims: A seven-issue dependency graph completed in merge order.
Detent returned dependent work to Todo after its prerequisite merged.

entries.title: My AI Orchestrator Is Dumb on Purpose
entries.summary: The orchestrator stays deliberately simple while checked-in configuration and workflow files hold the engineering judgment.
claims: Global configuration defines host-wide agent limits and project registration.
Project configuration binds tracker states, worktrees, gates, and merge-train behavior.
WORKFLOW.md carries the prose contract given to each agent.
